body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity on non-current maps** — the column should feel like ONE BIG MAP.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only.
- Basement solid rock; with Biomes! Caverns = living cavern. Stairwells do NOT exchange heat.
- Sky-view mountain = ONE connected vanilla rock texture per stone type; BM variant mode sanctioned exception (USER-VERIFIED). Outermost sky-mass ring always AB_MountainTop lip. Mined peak exposes open sky.
- Pod transit handoff LATE (22t). Below view PLUMB, dim 0.06. Mesa model rejected.
- **ALWAYS read `def.graphicData.Graphic`, never stale `def.graphic`**.
- **Settings IMGUI discipline**: deferred switches, snapshot-gated rows, measured heights, unconditional gutter.
- **Cross-level work: strictly-better rank only; main-thread sim only. CrossLevelDemand skips Blueprint_Install (material side; mini ferry is separate + built).**
- **TEXTURE POLICY**: user supplies all stair/ladder/elevator art; risers use host atlases.
- **Climb animations: vanilla pipeline only.**
- **Cross-map job guard doctrine (run #70)**: intercept third-party jobs whose targetA.Map != pawn.Map — replace with routing or NoJob. Lore saved.
- **MIGRATION DISCIPLINE (run #71)**: summary bits are a PRE-GATE only — never issue a migration stairs job without a REAL virtual-position probe finding doable work (colonists AND robots). Summary-only gating causes down-and-back bounces.
- **PARITY AUDIT IS THE ROADMAP**: docs/CrossLevelParityAudit.md is the living scope tracker; update as gaps close.

## RUN #71 BOUNCE FIX + VERIFY SWEEP (2026-07-23) — BUILT, compile green
- **Robot bounce (user report: bots cross then immediately return at 91% battery)**: WorkJobPostfix was summary-gated only — blueprints in basement + no materials = migrate, find nothing doable, idle go-home node (correctly) routes back. Fix: `CrossLevelWork.ProbeWorkAt` (internal wrapper over ProbeBetterWorkAt, full-list, claims probe budget) + ABMiscRobotsCompat.TryMigrate — summary pre-gate, then REAL probe of the robot's own giver list at the stairwell exit, StairRouter.Reroute to the probed work. Correct choreography: surface supply giver ferries materials down FIRST, then the probe lights up and the bot descends to real work.
- **Verify sweep (code-level) — COMPLETE**: research detector ✅ (bench+project); fire emergency pre-check ✅ (counts fires on linked levels); hunting ✅; corpse/container storage push ❌→FIXED: CrossLevelHaul.Check switched TryFindBestBetterStoreCellFor → **TryFindBestBetterStorageFor** (graves/caskets/modded container storage now valid cross-level push destinations; container resolves to its Position for routing); gatherings: Ideology rituals covered, non-Ideology GatheringWorker parties/marriages split out as GAP-P2.

## PARITY AUDIT (docs/CrossLevelParityAudit.md) — P0 done, queue awaiting user structuring
- **P0 FIXED**: install/uninstall ("Bring {mini} and install it here" + automatic mini ferry, also runs in robot enumerators; uninstall already migrated via designation detector).
- **P1 queue**: trade beacon aggregation (AllLaunchableThingsForTrade postfix); refuel + growth-vat demand (bills pattern); Biotech mech recharge routing (JobGiver_GetEnergy intercept, run-#70 doctrine); apparel optimization probe; transporter loading demand.
- **P2**: roof-area detector; non-Ideo gatherings; weapon pickup; drug refill; childcare; mechanitor repair; transfusion.
- **P3**: Anomaly containment; anima travel; turret gap targeting.

## RUN #70 FIXES — APPLIED (Robots++ dock loop: both patch shapes + cross-map intercept; fence patch param names). Open chores: translation report audit, palette pin watch.

## 2026-07-23 FEATURE TRANCHES (all compile green, verification rolling)
- Tranche 3: Robots++ work migration (now v2 probe-gated); "Bring {material} and build {thing}" forced order (FinishOnSite continuation).
- Tranche 2: Achtung! drags; meditation redirect; construction supply giver.
- Jobs settings tab (presets + sliders + flow checkboxes, consts settings-driven; Blueprint.SpawnSetup instant invalidation).
- Biome-driven sky plateaus (terrainsByFertility@0.7 + fallbacks).
- Climb/emerge animations + wide 2x1 stairs. Art tuner (bake fold-in pending).

## VERIFIED BASELINE (through run #62 + prior)
Priority-aware cross-level work; Misc. Robots base; select in place; bidirectional right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; risers (DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE); work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; through-gap combat; pod transit + AA; caravans; opt-in threats; world integration; column wealth; ritual attendance; social; camera level lock; naturalistic peaks; BC caverns; sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode; modder API.

## SETTINGS SUITE — six tabs, measured scrolls, presets, ABGuard panel + Re-arm, gen preview, Odyssey landmarks.

## Dev-tools ("As above")
ensure sky+basement; self-test suite (combat/auto-engage/targeting-hub/animal-wander/ritual-attendance/mech-overseer/bond+home/pod-transit/stair-routing/cavern-basement/peak-plateau); below-view diagnostic; probe ledge cell; cap corner fillers; DEV: Adjust art.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). Better Mountains + Medieval Overhaul (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots (verified) + Robots++ (probe-gated migration + dock fix, unverified). Achtung! drags (soft, unverified). Container storage (graves/caskets/Deep-Storage-style) as cross-level destinations (NEW, unverified). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-23: robot bounce fixed (probe-gated migration — new MIGRATION DISCIPLINE locked), verify sweep complete (2 fixes: container storage push, install ferry; research/fire/hunting confirmed), audit updated with changelog. All compile green — needs relaunch. NEXT: user structures the P1 build order (proposed: trade beacons -> refuel/vat demand -> mech recharge -> apparel -> transporter loading). Outstanding chores: translation report audit, palette pin watch, art bake fold-in, mech escort test, settings preview pass, landmark UI check, Forced smoke-vent gen, bond/home, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
